scope: Independent b0 pairwise selector only; no TOPUP field, EDDY, fitting or registration chain. Frozen twenty full-chain clocks and outputs are not replaced.
input_scope: Existing raw inputs read one subject at a time; no reference image is input to either selector; existing reference JSON choices are read for comparison.
timing_scope: Both pairwise_function_seconds_sum include float32 input conversion, pooling, transfer, LBFGS and returned score with explicit device synchronization and a detached-view observer. Legacy accepted-point diagnostic is outside those timers. Whole selector observer time separately includes the diagnostic; raw b0 loading is separate. No speed ratio is inferred.
memory_scope: Per-selector peak allocator allocated/reserved, including accepted-point diagnostic, after empty_cache/reset; CUDA context or other processes are not included. Peaks are not additive.

source.new_selector_status: Independent uncommitted accepted-point fix; whole-chain cohort remains the frozen commit.

public_redaction: The unique hardware UUID is omitted; algorithm, numerical, timing, input and source fields are retained.
